resolution.note: The Turkish embassy page on student military service deferral could not be reached, so the guide now cites the Education Counsellor's own FAQ and states only what it says.

edits.oldText:
afterBlockId: "us-docs-identity",
            blocks: [{ type: "paragraph", text: "Turkish men studying abroad at their own expense can have military service deferred once Turkish authorities recognise their student status: apply to the Education Counsellor (Eğitim Müşavirliği) at the Turkish embassy with the enrolment or acceptance letter, the previous diploma or its equivalence certificate, and a military status document [CITE: vasington-be.mfa.gov.tr/ogrenci-askerlik-erteleme].
edits.newText:
afterBlockId: "us-docs-identity",
            blocks: [{ type: "paragraph", text: "Turkish men studying abroad can have military service deferred only once the Turkish Education Counsellor's office (Eğitim Müşavirliği) recognises their student status, which needs a school recognised by YÖK: apply with the previous diploma or its equivalence certificate and documents showing that you are abroad and studying there [CITE: vasington.meb.gov.tr/sss].
